crid://csi.digitaluk.co.uk/87ada9a9-6d79.desc: One morning in the early Springtime, Little Nutbrown Hare wakes to find the air filled with a delightful smell.

crid://csi.digitaluk.co.uk/948adf9a-e7ef.desc: One clear Spring night, Little Nutbrown Hare and Little Field Mouse settle in to enjoy Little White Owl's story of adventure and treasures.

crid://csi.digitaluk.co.uk/cc8cdf32-4f6e.desc: Little Nutbrown Hare wakes early one Summer morning before the sun has risen. Big Nutbrown Hare sends Little Nutbrown Hare off to invite his friends for breakfast so he can rest a little longer.

crid://csi.digitaluk.co.uk/cf38b5da-a57f.desc: Little Nutbrown Hare finds a very special feather with bright colours, spots and soft tickly bits. Just as he shows off to his friends how it can fly and float, a cheeky bird flies away with it.

crid://csi.digitaluk.co.uk/71342319-d3ab.desc: Little Nutbrown Hare watches as Blue Bird's eggs hatch into three happy, chirpy baby birds. Fascinated and charmed by these youngsters, he visits them every day and even helps teach them.

crid://csi.digitaluk.co.uk/3da7c2c5-cf1d.desc: It's Spring blossom season and the pretty pink blossoms that come floating down the stream remind Big Nutbrown Hare of a magnificent cherry tree from his youth.

crid://csi.digitaluk.co.uk/a1a5c360-58d5.desc: Little Nutbrown Hare befriends a little yellow fluffy creature by the river, and it follows him everywhere, quacking and copying his every move.

crid://csi.digitaluk.co.uk/32394d82-79da.desc: Little Nutbrown Hare is disappointed when a trail of ants disappears with the delicious Spring berries he's found. He's convinced that ants are not very nice.

crid://csi.digitaluk.co.uk/5bae7ab8-9fa3.desc: One Spring morning a cute spotty ladybird lands on Little Nutbrown Hare and seems to want to stay with him. All his friends admire the interesting little creature and he feels very special indeed.

crid://csi.digitaluk.co.uk/a399ffab-c87d.desc: It is a sunny spring day in the meadow and Little Nutbrown Hare is enjoying all it has to offer.

crid://csi.digitaluk.co.uk/4e1f676b-9c13.desc: On Summer's hottest night Little Nutbrown Hare finds it hard to sleep.

crid://csi.digitaluk.co.uk/b7623094-8ba5.desc: On a cold but sunny morning in the middle of Winter, Little Nutbrown Hare discovers his friends ice-skating on the frozen pond. He decides to give it a try but slips, slops and slides all over the ice

crid://csi.digitaluk.co.uk/2db693d2-5b1d.desc: Little Nutbrown Hare decides he wants a clever long tail like his friends, rather than a short fluffy one. They help out by making him a long tail but all the results are either too tickly or bendy.
